component.name: HypoDJ
component.summary: Your music, played by a DJ that asks before it acts

description.p: HypoDJ is the GNOME desktop front end for the hypodj daemon, a music player that streams your OpenSubsonic library (Navidrome and friends) and speaks the MPD protocol.

The app shows what is playing, the queue and search, and controls playback and volume. It is a thin client: it needs a hypodj daemon running on the same machine or reachable over the network (127.0.0.1:6600 by default, overridable with HYPODJ_HOST and HYPODJ_PORT).
